crew.overview: A successful mod photographer in London whose world is bounded by fashion, pop music, marijuana, and easy sex, feels his life is boring and despairing. But in the course of a single day he unknowingly captures a death on film.
crew.title: Blow-Up

details.biography: Pierre Rouve was born on 12 January 1915 in Sofia, Bulgaria. He was a producer and writer, known for Blow-Up (1966), I Like Money (1961) and Cop-Out (1967). He was married to Sonia Joyce. He died on 11 December 1998 in London, England, UK.
details.name: Pierre Rouve
